description: Bring a deleted sprint back from its board's trash: its name, goal, days and state as they were (an active sprint comes back 'future' when another sprint of the board has started since — 'stateChanged'), with every issue it held that lies in the backlog now ('issues'). An issue that went into another sprint since stays there and is named in 'left' with where it lies — unless moveOthers=true, which moves it back too ('moved'). Deleted issues and those of projects you cannot open are only counted ('gone', 'hidden'). Every issue that comes back gets a line in its history, and the project's journal one for the sprint, in your name. 'id' is the sprint's id from list_sprint_trash or the one delete_sprint answered. Needs full write access to the project (member, admin or lead); a reporter, a commenter or a read-only member is refused with the reason, as is anybody while the project is paused or archived. Written in the project's journal under your name.

moveOthers.description: true: also move back the issues that went into another sprint since the delete. Left out: they stay where they are and are named in 'left'.
